verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly signals single-company stewardship: the repository sits under the facebook GitHub org, and community threads describe Facebook itself deciding React's relicensing from BSD+Patents to MIT. Nothing first-party documents a governance model, foundation membership or continuity commitments. missing for 10: first-party governance documentation, an explicit statement of foundation vs. company ownership, steering/maintainer structure details, continuity or neutrality commitments, independent corroboration of current governance

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether the framework is governed by a foundation or a single company, so I can assess long-term continuity and lock-in risk

citations.quote: Facebook chose MIT instead of Apache 2.0
the BSD+Patents license is being replaced
